status_note: Post-M4 exploratory mechanism motivated by exposed development diagnostics; not a fresh confirmatory study or global novelty claim
cache_reuse_rule: Reuse only after exact training-ID, feature, class-order, fold/configuration and provenance hashes match each inner or outer population; never substitute historical global OOF probabilities
raw_frame_support: Same existing memory union, approximately -3.0667 to +2.9333 seconds; retain exact frame-support manifests

hazard.node_inputs: Separate projection of the same 3072 training-standardized frozen visual node features used by M2-M5; six node-quality fields remain diagnostics only. No class probabilities, quality inputs, identity codes, center-relative time/slot, or utility-context embeddings
hazard.edge_inputs: ordered endpoint embeddings, signed difference, absolute difference
hazard.physical_interval: edge at destination connects previous available timestamp, including missing-slot bridges; require strictly increasing observed times
hazard.classification_gradient: Detached before either attention operator; hazard projection also detaches frozen input features
hazard.supervision: Any target-state change across the entire inclusive observed edge interval; mask unknown/ambiguous/missing annotation support
hazard.loss: Uniform unweighted masked BCE-with-logits; no positive weights, focal loss, oversampling or post-hoc threshold
hazard.calibration_caveat: Proper loss does not guarantee finite-sample calibration; independence across edges is a model assumption

attention.control: softmax(utility + detached_log_path_survival), center survival 1; no epsilon floor
attention.candidate: Independent left/right stopping endpoints; normalize utility within each contiguous observed segment containing center, then average by segment probability
attention.coefficient_bound: For each neighbor j: attention_j <= predicted_path_survival_j, up to floating-point tolerance; final neighbor coefficient gate*attention_j also satisfies this
attention.not_claimed: Not guaranteed true-state survival, not a bound on all indirect contextual feature influence, and not a new source of class probability mass
attention.fusion: Same original-probability center mixture and learned gate in both arms; bias -4; exact singleton/zero-gate fallback

batch_status: Proposed same batch as existing memory; new synthetic GPU resource check required before execution lock
classification_loss: Current meta-training population balanced center NLL
gradient_clipping: Norm 1 independently for hazard_* parameters and all other parameters; never one global clip that couples classifier and hazard updates
feature_scaling: Only current meta-training centers, same existing visual-feature statistics recipe; six quality fields remain diagnostics only; neighbors restricted to the same allowed scenario population
selection: Pooled inner best-checkpoint macro-F1 descending, NLL ascending, learning-rate ascending, weight-decay ascending; no outer diagnostic tuning
outer_refit_epochs: Rounded median of selected configuration's three best inner epochs
seed_aggregation: Unweighted probability mean of outer seeds 42,43,44; never pick best outer seed

fit_budget.formula: 2 arms * 5 outer folds * (4 optimizer settings * 3 inner fits + 3 outer seed refits)
fit_budget.estimate_not_measurement: About 25-45 minutes if early-stopping behavior resembles completed memory fits; reserve up to 2.5 hours for all 30 epochs plus validation/I/O. New candidate GPU throughput remains unmeasured.

required_audit: Lock prototype, runner, protocol, tests, data and nested-base lineage in a new run directory; active runs unchanged
Verify separate gradient clipping, unweighted BCE, train-only feature statistics and no known boundary labels in forward
Check held hazard NLL/Brier and reliability by physical duration; report repeated-edge occurrence-weighted and physical-edge-deduplicated summaries
Report all-row macro-F1/accuracy/NLL/Brier, seeds, scenarios, sampled boundaries, full-interval boundaries, stable and unknown subsets
Report rescues/harms against fixed references and matched control, including all 508 historical shared failures without selecting them for training
Audit maximum attention-minus-survival and final neighbor-coefficient-minus-survival; allow only documented numerical tolerance
Separate hazard calibration improvements from marginalization effect; do not attribute candidate-vs-old-M4 changes solely to the new operator
No radius, threshold, hazard temperature or utility tuning against exposed outer outcomes

statistics.primary: Paired exact scenario-swap test across 11 scenarios for expected_episode minus matched control
statistics.uncertainty: Scenario-block bootstrap; report individual seeds and probability-mean system
statistics.scope: Exploratory repeated-use development evidence, not independent confirmation
